Settings and custom rows

Build native plugin settings using the compatibility or native SDK.

Standard settings

Use ui.settings.Switch, Selector, Input, EditText, Text, Header and Divider. Return rows from create_settings(). The host stores values and triggers callbacks.

Custom rows

Use Custom for an Android View or UItem. SimpleSettingFactory separates creation, binding and click behavior. Call set_setting(..., reload_settings=True) when an edit changes the structure of the settings page.
